# pm-skills (selected)

Source: https://github.com/phuryn/pm-skills (~24k★)

Vendored **subset** for APDR offline reference. Prefer installing the full marketplace in Cursor/Codex for slash commands (`/discover`, `/strategy`, etc.).

- brainstorm-ideas-new, identify-assumptions-new, prioritize-assumptions
- opportunity-solution-tree, prioritize-features, brainstorm-experiments-new

### pm-market-research
- competitor-analysis, user-personas, customer-journey-map, market-segments

### pm-product-strategy
- lean-canvas, product-strategy, value-proposition
